open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 camera-time conversion
open_points.text: when its conversion to UTC fails, a moment that type cannot hold among them
open_points.question: What exactly counts as a failed UTC conversion, which intermediate or resulting moment is meant by “a moment that type cannot hold,” and which conversion errors merely make this camera candidate unusable rather than refusing or aborting the delivery?
options: Only overflow or an out-of-range UTC result makes the camera candidate unusable.
Any exception raised while applying the offset or run timezone makes the camera candidate unusable.
Value-dependent conversion errors make the candidate unusable, while configuration or timezone-provider errors refuse the operation.
open_points.default_guess: Treat representational overflow or another error caused by the camera value as making that candidate unusable; do not silently turn configuration or infrastructure failures into EXIF fallback.

open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 and A7 rule 4 modification-time conversion
open_points.text: A modification time is an absolute instant converted to UTC.
open_points.question: What must delivery return when the file modification time cannot be represented or converted to the required UTC datetime, either as the fallback photo moment or for the latest-after-modified comparison?
options: Refuse the whole request with a specified RefusalCode.
Define such modification times as impossible through an explicit input invariant.
open_points.default_guess: Return FAILED with UNREADABLE_FILE because the required metadata value cannot be used.

witness.initial: A regular supported image has no usable EXIF camera time, and its metadata reading succeeds but yields a modification instant outside the datetime representation used by the service.
events: The calling flow requests delivery of the file.
The deliverer reaches the modification-time fallback and attempts to convert that instant to UTC.
outcomes: The delivery returns FAILED with UNREADABLE_FILE.
The conversion error escapes or is mapped to a different placement failure or whole-operation refusal.
witness.observer: The calling flow sees a different response status or failure code.
